name: Nijou Aya
source:
She is the secretary and treasurer of the student council.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akane_Iro_ni_Somaru_Saka]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler] It is unknown if Aya is part of secret fraction like other student spies but is aware of them and shown to be very capable of gathering intel. Will more less keep to self but will help when friends in a pinch.  [/spoiler]
